title: File Coordination Marker v1
description: Schema for the coordination file-marker protocol declared by file_markers.py. Content-light: stores hashes, not raw paths or contents.

protocol.description: Protocol identifier for the file coordination marker.

session_id.description: Session ID that owns this file claim.

task_id.description: Task ID within the session that claimed the file.

marker_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the marker payload.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of claim creation.

state.description: Current state of the file claim marker.

released_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when claim was released.
